title: Some Results on Lame-Heun Spectral Geometry
summary: We develop a unified spectral and complex analytic theory of the Lame equation through its canonical Heun realization. Starting with ellipsoidal separation, we derive essential elements, including the Lame-preserving anharmonic parameter action and finite accessory spectral polynomials. We construct the global Heun monodromy representation on the four-punctured sphere, connected to the (2,2,2,2) pillowcase orbifold and the SL(2,C) character surface. The accessory parameter is framed within a Riemann-Hilbert map that links spectral values to monodromy conditions. Utilizing Seifert van Kampen…
